messages:
Olivia Hart: Quick heads-up from finance: starting June 1, 2026 were tightening documentation for any non-recurring vendor spend > $1,500. Required items: invoice/quote, vendor contact, and expected delivery date. See portal: https://redwood.example.com/finance/non-recurring-policy

Marcus Nguyen: Thanks Olivia. Does this apply to hardware purchases for R&D prototypes?

Olivia Hart: Yes it does. Hardware counts as non-recurring. For prototype hardware under $1,500 use the existing corp card workflow. For anything above, open a PO in the Supplier Portal and attach the quote + vendor contact.

R&D Ops: Can we request a short exception window for urgent bench purchases? Lead time on some parts is 48 hours and the PO turnaround is slower.

Olivia Hart: If it's urgent, use the "expedite" checkbox in the intake form and add "urgent-bench" to the notes. Procurement will triage same-day for qualifying requests, but we still need the invoice/quote attached within 48 hours of charge.

Marcus Nguyen: Understood. Any change to virtual card rules? We've been using vcards for one-off vendor trials.

Olivia Hart: No policy change to vcards themselves. Reminder: vcard single-charge cap remains $2,000 and receipts must be uploaded within 3 business days. Recurring SaaS should NOT use one-off vcards; please request a vendor onboarding and recurring payment mapping in the portal.

ReceiptsBot: Automated notice: receipts missing after 7 days will be flagged and the card-holder will be required to submit an exception ticket.

Vendor Success: Heads-up for vendor managers  if you expect to exceed $25k with a new supplier across 12 months, start procurement + legal early. Parallel review reduces delays.

Olivia Hart: Also publishing GL codes for common categories to avoid miscoding: "SW-SUB" -> 5300, "HW-TEST" -> 5402, "MKT-CONT" -> 4625. Please include `project_code` on POs for chargeback.

Marcus Nguyen: I'll share with the PMs. One more Q: will provisional POs still be available for legacy vendors?

Olivia Hart: Provisional POs remain for legacy vendors but are limited to $3,000 and expire after 21 days. Use them only for short-term holds; convert to a formal PO ASAP.

R&D Ops: Thanks. We'll add the vendor contact step to our intake checklist.

Olivia Hart: Thanks team. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've read the update so procurement can close the loop.
